raw_segments.text: Sarah Pocket conducted me down, as if I were a ghost who must be seen out.
She could not get over my appearance, and was in the last degree confounded.
But she merely stared, and did not seem collected enough to know that I had spoken.
Clear of the house, I made the best of my way back to Pumblechuck.
S. took off my new clothes, made them into a bundle, and went back home in my older dress,
carrying it, to speak the truth.
Much more at my ease, too, though I had the bundle to carry.
